root_cause: A single-valued property (the size of the one sample making up a still HEIF/AVIF image) was modeled as a dynamically allocated array sized for the general multi-sample track case, instead of as a scalar. The invariant that this array always has exactly one valid element was not (and, given the surrounding generic box-parsing code, could not reliably be) enforced at every point where the array was later indexed by the shared mov_build_index() logic, leading to out-of-bounds/NULL-like access when the invariant was violated by crafted input.
findings: For HEIF still images, heif_add_stream() synthesizes a MOVStreamContext for the item and allocates sc->sample_sizes (and sc->chunk_offsets/sc->stsc_data/sc->stts_data) as a heap array with exactly one element, unconditionally setting sc->sample_count = 1.
